description: M3 production capability — main window only, local content only. Allows ping + typed terminal lifecycle (portable-pty backend). No shell, filesystem, http, process, opener, or remote capabilities. Tauri semantic mapping: terminal::* -> terminal_* invoke ids. Clipboard: native read/write text only — added because navigator.clipboard.readText failed in real Linux WebKit/Tauri during Human M3 desktop testing; empirically required.
